allocation.rebalance: Sell target reductions before buys; reserve cash and fees; no borrowing, leverage, forced investment or fixed position-count cap
allocation.weight_rule: Each active asset receives 1/N of equity for the preregistered universe size N, with fees reserved; inactive allocations remain cash. For the current two-asset study this is 0.5 each, not a permanent asset/position-count cap.

data_permission_resolution: Do not treat uncertainty about one exchange as a project-wide blocker. Use another suitable source as needed; do not assume every provider permits unrestricted access or redistribution.

dataset_admission.quality: No gaps, valid OHLC/nonnegative volume; fixed limited universe only
dataset_admission.use_boundary: Supported public API, private research, no raw-data redistribution; not an unrestricted commercial-data license
dataset_admission.coverage_binding: Existing development fold dates fit source history. No strategy performance examined before freezing this admission.

recovery.reason: Original local data/ledger missing; six bounded collector requests recovered identical normalized development prices. Retrieval metadata recaptured; original results unchanged.

poc.sequence: Complete S1 research review before S2 volume/technical signals, then S3 mean reversion. No automatic batch expansion.
poc.other_registered_variants: Only the one S2-001 development pilot is active; S1 closed and all other variants paused. No holdout access.

s2_spec.entry: When previously inactive: close[t] > close[t-20] AND volume[t] > 1.5 * mean(volume[t-20:t]); latest completed day t excluded from volume mean. Equality does not enter.
s2_spec.hold_exit: When previously active: remain active while close[t] > close[t-20], irrespective of current volume. Exit when close[t] <= close[t-20]. No profit target, stop-loss or time exit.
s2_spec.zero_volume_mean: Zero prior mean blocks entry; zero latest volume blocks entry. Neither forces exit of an active trend. Missing/negative/nonfinite volume fails data validation, not an invented zero.
s2_spec.initial_state: Both signal states inactive at first scored decision, independent of starting owned inventory; no pre-scored signal state reconstruction.
s2_spec.allocation: Reuse daily equal-universe 1/N fee-reserved targets, inactive weight stays cash; daily resizing remains possible.
s2_spec.data: Existing admitted Bitstamp BTC/USD and ETH/USD daily OHLCV; volume is venue-specific base volume, normalized separately within each asset.
s2_spec.timing: Only completed available bars, existing publication/processing lags and future daily-open proxies.
s2_spec.parameters_authority: Agent-selected simple working hypothesis after seeing S1, not optimized or a paper replication. No S2 historical signals or returns examined before specification.
s2_spec.budget_slot: Replaces unexecuted TREND-365 reservation, whose old definition remains for provenance; selection cap and multiplicity divisor remain 18.
s2_spec.implementation_reuse: Existing signal interface, data loader, allocator, execution, ledger and reports; no framework migration or third-party code copy.
s2_spec.evaluation_scope: One development pilot only, then reject/inconclusive or register missing robustness before any promotion. Holdout access not authorized.
